title: fix(console): on a desktop the way-home controls name the app start page, and the pill drops its duplicate All apps row
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Fixes #37163

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：桌面端应用切换菜单去掉了多余的「全部应用」一行；找不到页面、无权访问、AI 不可用等页面上的「返回首页」按钮，以及左上角产品标志的读屏名称，改为「返回应用起始页」；手机端完全不变。
- 为什么做：属于「去掉顶栏和平台首页那一层」专题的收尾，桌面端平台首页已下线，这几处还在承诺一个不存在的首页或应用列表。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某处文案读起来不顺，跳转目标没有任何改动；可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Measured first, at `origin/main` a10345abf. From 768 px up `useHomePath()` answers `resolveDesktopHomePath` (the last-used app, else the declared default, else the first product app). Desktop `/home` redirects into that app (`HomeRoute` → `RootLandingRedirect`) and draws only the no-apps empty state for a viewer with no product app. So no desktop page lists the apps. The pill's 「Switch Application」 group lists every app the launcher serves (`useLauncherApps`, Setup as the 「Settings」 row). It has no cap.

- `layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`: the 「All apps」 row (`app-switcher-all-apps`) is removed. It linked to `homePath`, the same target as the 「Back to app start page」 row above it, and the switch group is the list it promised. This dropdown is desktop-only: a phone opens the app-list sheet, which never had the row. The `LayoutGrid` import and the stale comments go with it.
- `components/NotFoundState.tsx` `BackToHomeButton` (access denied, verdict screens and route-not-found in `AppContent.tsx`, plus `RecordDetailView.tsx`): reads `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` 「Back to app start page」 from 768 px up and `empty.appAccessDeniedHome` 「Back to home」 on a phone (`usePhoneViewport`, imported directly so the component still does not load the `useHomePath` module graph).
- `console/ai/AiUnavailable.tsx`: same split for its way-home button.
- `layout/AppHeader.tsx`: the product mark's `aria-label` is `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome` on a desktop and `layout.appSwitcher.productHome` 「PRODUCT home」 on a phone. `title` stays the product name.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: untouched. No key added or removed (`backToHome` already reads 「Back to app start page」 / 返回应用起始页 in all eleven locales since #37159; `allApps`, `productHome`, `appAccessDeniedHome` and `unavailableHome` keep their phone readers). Hence `Clause-②: no`.
- Targets: unchanged everywhere.

Serial constraint with #37166 (zone a4-S; it also edits `AiUnavailable.tsx` and three StudioRoute console tests). Round 1's one-line import overlap in `AiUnavailable.tsx` was removed by moving the import one line up. Round 2 (head `156171ded`) updates three console tests to the desktop wording. They are `StudioRoute.test.tsx:387` and `StudioRoute.lazyBuilder-11798.test.tsx:187`, which looked the mark up by its phone name at jsdom's 1024 px, and `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx:150`, whose old-name absence check could no longer fail; it now checks `data-testid="app-bar-product-home"`. Those three files conflict textually with #37166. By the seat's ruling this PR lands first, and #37166 resolves them as follows: it keeps its own deletion of the two front-door tests, and on `metadataArea-28561` keeps its comment line plus this PR's test-id assertion (posted on #37166 as 7153261562). `overlap-check` at `156171ded`: `origin/main`, #37215 and #37185 merge cleanly; the only overlap is #37166 in those three files.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`: the removed row (the only behaviour change besides labels).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/NotFoundState.tsx`: the viewport choice shared by four screens.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`: the mark's `label` ternary.

Two-minute check: at a desktop width, open any app's pill. The menu lists the apps, then 「Back to app start page ⌘⇧H」 and 「Settings」, with no 「All apps」. Open `/apps/APP/no-such-page`: the button reads 「Back to app start page」. Narrow the window under 768 px and the same page reads 「Back to home」.

## Tests

Pins per surface at desktop width, with the phone as the CONTROL. Each new pin is a top-level `describe` in the surface's existing harness:
- App pill: `AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605`. The outline has no `app-switcher-all-apps`, exactly one link to the app start page, and every app in the switch group. Phone control: the drawer's 「All apps」 still pinned, unchanged, in `UnifiedSidebar.mobileAppHeader-12201`.
- `BackToHomeButton`: `NotFoundState.test`. At 1280 px it reads 「Back to app start page」 with no "home" in it. CONTROL at 375 px: 「Back to home」, opens `/home`.
- `AiUnavailable`: `RequireAiSurface.test`. Desktop reads `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome`. CONTROL on a phone: `console.ai.unavailableHome`.
- Product mark: `AppHeader.homeMark-12605`. At 1280 px its accessible name is 「Back to app start page」 and `title` the product name. CONTROL at 375 px on `/home`: 「PRODUCT home」, href `/home`.

Existing pins re-pointed to the desktop wording, or to `app-switcher-home` in place of the removed row: `AppSwitcher.appIdentity-12201`, `AppSwitcher.hostSingleApp-12913`, `AppHeader.pageRouteNoAuthoringHandles-12198`, `RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902`, `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished`, `AppContent.noAppComponentRoutes`.

## Acceptance notes

- `RequireAiSurface`'s published `redirectTo` prop can send the no-assistant screen's button somewhere other than `useHomePath()`. No in-repo caller passes it. The desktop label assumes the default target.
- On a desktop the way home briefly names `/home` until the `/me/apps` answer is held, or for a viewer with no product app, where `/home` draws the no-apps empty state. That is the same caveat #37159 accepted for the ⌘⇧H row.
- The `console.ai.unavailableError` sentence still says "head back home" on a desktop. Fixing it needs a new locale key, so it stays outside this diff (see report).
- Same family, outside this card's file surface: `ui/apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx` `StudioAccessRequired` 「Back to home」 links to `useHomePath()`. It is in #37166's diff, so it is reported rather than touched. Also stale prose only: `runtime-config.ts` (the `hideSingleAppSwitcher` doc mentions the 「All apps」 row) and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` (the switcher offers "Showcase, Back to home and All apps").

## Verification

Round 2, head `156171ded`: the 3 StudioRoute files `Tests 34 passed (34)`; the red leg (the two files at their old content) gave `Tests 2 failed | 20 passed (22)`; a broad sweep of 872 test files `Tests 8296 passed (8296)`; the derived gate families, 38 of 38 exit 0. CI at this head: 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed.

Round 1, head 646cd3e8a. Local: affected suites, ablation, app-shell type-check, touched-file eslint, the derived gate families. CI owns the full farm.
